messages.author: fc22cb727156ff4f
messages.subject: Re: extract coordinates from contour line
parts:
On Sun, Nov 29, 2009 at 04:53, Julius Tesoro <jute...@yahoo.com> wrote:
> no not really, i just want to store the contour values at a certain elevation.

In that case you need to use the function that ggplot uses internally
to compute the contour lines (which you can find in the source code in
stat-contour.r): contourLines. It is a regular R function so:

?contourLines

JiHO
